title: Under-five mortality
source: United Nations, SDG Global Database (United Nations Statistics Division); custodian: UN Inter-agency Group for Child Mortality Estimation (UN IGME)
retrieved_via: UN System Data Commons (MCP connector): get_observations(Earth, date=all); get_child_observations(parent=Earth, child_place_type=Country, date=latest)
notes: SDG target 3.2 asks every country to reduce under-five mortality to at least as low as 25 per 1,000 live births by 2030, so the yardstick is a count of countries above that threshold in their latest estimate, not a world pace. Country values are UN IGME estimates; all refer to 2024 in this snapshot. Country display names are the Data Commons place names as retrieved. The 199 places include some territories (e.g. Anguilla, Montserrat).
